newsitem.title: USA: US Rep. Saxton again urges Fed to resist rate rise.
newsitem.headline: US Rep. Saxton again urges Fed to resist rate rise.

text.p: The chairman of the Joint Economic Committee, Rep. Jim Saxton, Thursday renewed his call for the Federal Reserve to resist raising interest rates at next Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
"The most recent data on the PPI (producer price index) and the CPI (consumer price index) confirm again that there is no evidence of inflation in the U.S. economy," he said in a statement.
"If we are concerned about price inflation, the focus should be on prices, not economic growth or labor markets," the New Jersey Republican said.
